title: Trial to harvest mapping for one synthetic wheat trial
branch: local main (working tree; no commit created)
scientificQuestion: Can an independent system recover, for each plot in a wheat trial, the cultivar planted, the irrigation actually applied, the relevant soil and weather context, and the measured grain yield?

findings.reason: BrAPI v2.1 does have an irrigation-capable Event resource with plot-level affected units, so plot-level applied irrigation can be recovered via BrAPI Event (read). The earlier claim that BrAPI v2.1 has no irrigation resource is incorrect. Remaining gaps: (a) no standardized eventParameter name/units for applied water depth, (b) no released write endpoint/schema, (c) GenX IrrigationEvent still lacks plot/observation-unit attribution.
findings.acceptanceCondition: A BrAPI Event with eventType='irrigation', observationUnitDbIds=['plot-a'], eventDateRange.discreteDates=[timestamp], and eventParameters containing applied water depth 20 mm validates against the released Event schema and resolves plot-a; a fixture that substitutes another valid plot in the same study still passes structural checks and is only exposed by an independent irrigation log.

findings.writeSupport: No Events_POST or EventNewRequest in the released BrAPI v2.1 source inspected; write path is not defined in released contracts.

findings.reason: BrAPI v2.1 Observation + ObservationVariable can record a plot's grain yield value, timestamp, and study, with trait/method/scale defining the measurement basis. FX-003 demonstrates 6 kg dry grain from 10 m^2 reported as 6000 kg/ha (ICASA HWAH, dry matter) for plot-a (cv-alpha). A harvest occurrence is recorded separately as a BrAPI Event (eventType='harvest') with affected units, dates, and parameters; it does not carry harvested quantity/moisture/area. BrAPI v2.1 Event supports eventType='harvest' (ICASA management events) with affected observation units, dates, and parameters.
findings.acceptanceCondition: An independent client can retrieve an Observation for the plot's observationUnitDbId whose variable is grain yield (HWAH, dry matter, kg/ha) and read value, timestamp, study, and cultivar; and distinguish it from a harvest Event and from seed-lot/operational traceability.

findings.reason: HarvestRecord requires quantity and unit but leaves moisture and area optional and defines no moisture basis or plot link, so grain yield cannot be unambiguously compared across plots. FX-003 shows the BrAPI Observation path resolves plot, cultivar, harvest timing, dry-weight basis, and reported value without a HarvestRecord; GenX HarvestRecord remains useful for operational/seed-lot traceability (seedLotDbId) but needs a plot/observationUnit link and an explicit moisture-basis rule before it can carry comparable yield. Harvest occurrence can be recorded as a BrAPI Event (eventType='harvest'); yield quantity/moisture/area remain Observation/HarvestRecord semantics.
findings.acceptanceCondition: A HarvestRecord states moisture basis (moisture + moistureUnit plus a basis flag or reference to an ObservationVariable scale) and a plot/observationUnit link, or an Event-based harvest record defines equivalent quantity/moisture/area semantics, and a fixture with an ambiguous measurement basis is rejected. GenX extension recommended only if a concrete exchange (seed-lot/operational traceability) still loses meaning.

workedTrace.title: One worked record trace (synthetic wheat trial)
workedTrace.prose: Trial 'wheat-trial-network-2026' (BrAPI Trial) contains Study 'wheat-yield-trial-2026' (BrAPI Study) at Location 'field-12' (BrAPI Location, WGS84 coordinates). The study has two cultivars, 'cv-alpha' and 'cv-beta' (BrAPI Germplasm), and two planned irrigation levels, 'low-water' and 'high-water'. Each of the four plots is a BrAPI ObservationUnit carrying germplasmDbId, observationLevel='plot', position, and ObservationTreatment with factor='irrigation' and the assigned modality; this is the planned treatment. GenX Plot records (plotDbId) exist for the same four plots but, because the current schema has no observationUnitDbId or studyDbId, an external mapping table is required to join plotDbId to observationUnitDbId. Soil context comes from a GenX SoilProfile at location 'field-12' with sampledAt and soil properties; however, the current schema has no sampling depth and no plot link, so the profile is site-level and its depth interval is unstated. Weather context comes from GenX WeatherObservation records for station 'ws-07' at location 'field-12' with observedAt timestamps and measurements; they are site/station-level and their aggregation window and representativeness are unstated. Applied irrigation can be recorded as a BrAPI Event with eventType='irrigation', observationUnitDbIds (e.g. plot-a), eventDateRange.discreteDates, and eventParameters (e.g. applied water depth 20 mm); this supports plot-level attribution on read. The GenX IrrigationEvent remains field/study-level (no plot/observation-unit link). Planned vs applied irrigation are separate records with no explicit link. Measured grain yield is recorded either as a BrAPI Observation for each plot's ObservationUnit (value, timestamp, grain-yield variable) or as a GenX HarvestRecord with quantity, unit, moisture, moistureUnit, and areaHarvested; the HarvestRecord has no plot/observationUnit link and no moisture-basis rule, so yield comparison across plots requires an external convention. FieldGeometry may describe the field boundary and area, but it has no location or plot link in the current schema, so it cannot by itself identify the harvested experimental unit.

negativeCases.title: Wrong-plot irrigation event
negativeCases.description: An Event is recorded with eventType='irrigation' and observationUnitDbIds=['plot-b'], although the independent field log shows water was applied to plot-a.
negativeCases.expected: Structural checks pass (plot-b is a valid plot in the study), but the independent irrigation log recording plot-a exposes the discrepancy; detection depends on cross-checking the Event against the independent log, not on the Event schema.

negativeCases.title: Soil data with no sampling depth

negativeCases.expected: Reject or mark incomplete because the depth interval to which the values apply is unstated.

negativeCases.title: Yield with an ambiguous measurement basis
negativeCases.description: A HarvestRecord states quantity and unit but omits moisture, moistureUnit, areaHarvested, and moisture basis, or an Observation variable scale does not state moisture basis.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag because grain yield cannot be compared across plots without a stated moisture basis and harvested area.

negativeCases.description: An Observation references an observationVariableDbId that does not resolve to an ObservationVariable with trait, method, and scale.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag; yield cannot be interpreted without a resolved variable defining trait, method, scale, and moisture basis.

negativeCases.description: A yield reported in kg/ha whose moisture basis is fresh or unspecified.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag; only dry-matter basis (ICASA HWAH) is accepted in this fixture.

negativeCases.expected: Absence remains unknown; a recorded zero is a measured application of zero and must be distinguished.

unknowns: Whether GenX Plot is intended to replace, mirror, or supplement the BrAPI ObservationUnit plot level.
Whether soil sampling depth should be a property of SoilProfile or a separate sample record with horizon semantics.
Whether weather station representativeness radius, sensor height, and aggregation window belong in WeatherObservation or in station metadata.
Whether IrrigationEvent volume is per field, per plot, or per application zone, and how application efficiency/runoff should be recorded.
Whether HarvestRecord quantity is as-harvested or dry mass, and what standard moisture basis (for example 14% for wheat) applies.
Whether cultivar identity should be BrAPI Germplasm or a GenX crop-species/taxon reference for this trial.
Whether planned treatment assignment should be BrAPI ObservationTreatment, GenX TreatmentAssignment, or both with an explicit link.

readerCanEstablish: The plot's planned irrigation modalities (low-water and high-water) from ObservationUnit.treatments.
The applied event occurrence, affected plot, timestamp, and applied depth (20 mm) from BrAPI Event.
plannedToAppliedTest.readerCannotEstablish: Which planned modality the event fulfilled; no shared identifier or state links ObservationTreatment to Event.
plannedToAppliedTest.recommendation: Document an explicit planned-treatment reference convention (e.g., Event.additionalInfo or a documented plannedApplicationId) before considering a schema change; only propose a new field if the pilot must distinguish planned vs applied irrigation and the convention cannot carry it.

yieldFixture.description: Executable BrAPI v2.1 yield fixture: plot-a (cv-alpha) grain yield as a released Observation + ObservationVariable, with a dry-matter moisture basis (ICASA HWAH) and a traceable source measurement (6 kg dry grain from 10 m^2 -> 6000 kg/ha). Harvest occurrence recorded separately as a BrAPI Event (eventType='harvest').

trait.traitDescription: Mass of grain harvested per unit area, dry matter basis.

method.methodName: Harvested grain dry weight per harvested area
method.description: Harvested grain dried to dry matter, weighed, divided by harvested area.

sourceMeasurement.note: 6 kg of dry grain harvested from 10 m^2 of harvested area within a 20 m^2 plot; harvested area is less than full plot area.

eventParameters.name: harvest_yield_harvest_dw
eventParameters.description: ICASA Measured_data.csv: HWAH = Harvested yield at harvest (dry wt), kg/ha.

relatedEntries.description: Harvest yield at harvest maturity (dry wt)
Moisture content of fresh yield at harvest

vocabulary.note: HWAH records harvested yield at harvest on a dry-weight basis (kg/ha), distinct from HWAM yield at harvest maturity (dry wt). Fresh-weight counterparts (HWAHF/HFAH) are separate variables; moisture basis must be stated explicitly.

relationshipChecks.detail: Observation.observationUnitDbId=plot-a resolves to a plot in study institute-a:study:wheat-yield-trial-2026.
Observation.observationVariableDbId resolves to an ObservationVariable with trait/method/scale and dry-matter units kg/ha.
6 kg dry grain / 10 m^2 = 6000 kg/ha; source measurement and calculation recorded.
harvestedArea (10 m^2) is less than fullPlotArea (20 m^2); distinction preserved.
Harvest occurrence recorded as a separate BrAPI Event (eventType='harvest'); yield value recorded as Observation.

negativeCases.description: An Observation references an observationVariableDbId that does not resolve to an ObservationVariable with trait/method/scale.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag; yield cannot be interpreted without a resolved variable defining trait, method, scale, and moisture basis.

negativeCases.description: An Observation for plot-c (foreign study) is joined to study institute-a:study:wheat-yield-trial-2026.
A yield reported in kg/ha whose moisture basis is fresh or unspecified.
negativeCases.expected: Reject or flag; only dry-matter (HWAH) basis is accepted in this fixture; fresh (HWAHF/HFAH) must be stated explicitly.
Remain unknown; distinguish from a recorded application of zero (IRVAL value 0).

yieldFixture.notes: Observation.value is a string per released BrAPI schema; unit and moisture basis are encoded in the ObservationVariable scale (kg/ha, dry matter) and cited ICASA HWAH entry. Harvested area (10 m^2) differs from full plot area (20 m^2). Absence of irrigation evidence on plot-b is unknown, not zero.
